thread:
Mike S (Sales): Quick handoff — GalaxyCare (mid-market health). Contract signed, pilot window starts in ~3 weeks. Customer insists on Private deployment in their Azure VNet for PHI. Main risks: SSO delay, KMS/HSM requirement, and VPC peering + egress rules. Need CS owner, eng on-call for infra tickets, and an onboarding runbook. TL;DR: timeline tight, high renewal upside if pilot succeeds.

Anya C (CS): I can own the account. I'll coordinate enablement and customer runbook. First steps: confirm SSO provider (Okta), gather network CIDRs, and schedule a kickoff. Who can own eng tickets?

Sam R (Eng): @Anya C I can take infra tickets for the pilot. Need exact network details and confirmation on customer-managed KMS vs. Redwood-managed. Also: are they doing private Dedicated or an on-prem package?

Mike S (Sales): They're requesting Private (customer-managed network) with full data isolation — likely private Dedicated in their Azure subscription. SSO = Okta (SCIM + OIDC). KMS: they prefer HSM-backed keys via their Azure Key Vault.

Luis G (Onboarding): I'll collect the CIDRs and app egress requirements. Can you ask them for a test subnet and a contact for the network admin? Also flagging that their security team requires SOC2 attestation and a short architecture diagram.

Anya C (CS): Action items I'm capturing:
- Owner: Anya C (CS) — overall launch lead.
- Infra owner: Sam R (Eng) — VNet peering, NAT, firewall rules.
- Onboarding contact: Luis G — customer network details + runbook prep.
- Compliance docs: CS to pull SOC2 + redwood private deployment sheet.

Sam R (Eng): Noted. For the pilot infra tickets, please create one consolidated ticket with attachments: network diagram, CVR for Okta SCIM endpoints, and KMS access pattern. Prefer format: `ENG-<component>-<shortdesc>`, e.g., `ENG-network-galaxycare`.

Mike S (Sales): Filing the initial context doc in the account folder: https://redwood.example.com/accounts/galaxycare/context (customer-facing material sanitized). I'll attach signed SOW and contact list there.

Deploy Bot: Provisioning request created — req-9821. Status: pending (awaiting tickets ENG-network-galaxycare & ENG-kms-integration).

Anya C (CS): Risks/notes:
- Renewal risk: medium-high if pilot delayed >6 weeks.
- Blocking items: SSO test users for SCIM + KMS key wrap tests.
- Success metric: <100ms P50 inference on Dedicated during pilot (customer KPI).

Luis G (Onboarding): Suggested kickoff times: next Tue 10am PT or Wed 2pm PT. I'll DM the customer to lock time and request network contacts.

Sam R (Eng): I'll set up a placeholder ticket `ENG-network-galaxycare` and upload a checklist template. Planning tasks: peering config, route propagation, NAT rules, and a smoke test plan (curl to health endpoints behind the private endpoint).

Anya C (CS): Next steps (short):
1) Mike attach SOW & network contact (by EOD).
2) Luis collect CIDRs + confirm kickoff (by 48h).
3) Mike create consolidated ENG ticket or link separate ones to `ENG-network-galaxycare` (by 24h).
4) Sam to triage once ticket(s) exist and schedule technical sync.

Mike S (Sales): On it — I'll attach docs and ping the network admin now.

Sam R (Eng): A couple quick asks for the ticket: include expected pod count, burst QPS, and whether KV cache will be used (affects egress to KMS).

Anya C (CS): I'll run the kickoff agenda draft and share a Google Calendar invite once Luis confirms time.

Mike S (Sales): Thanks all. Wrapping: high priority pilot, cross-team owners assigned. Please call out any blockers ASAP. :thumbsup:

Luis G (Onboarding): I'll post network details here when I have them.

Anya C (CS): Aiming for a kickoff within 48-72h. Thanks team. :raised_hands:
